name: IntegrateIT Metrics & Insights
notes: Samples any Control4 device variable into a bounded three-tier ledger (recent samples, hourly buckets, daily buckets), publishes min/max/average/trend insight variables plus new-extreme, significant-change, and rollover events, and exports CSV or JSON for external charting. Local-calendar bucketing, an explicit privacy mode, a capped project-backup footprint, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
